title: Moving from COD lists blank-term customers but never Counter Sale
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds COD, customer {Customer-B} has a blank credit term, and the organization's Counter Sale customer, {Customer-C}, is on COD.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-02 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-02 Blank (imported with an empty term) and {Customer-C} is the built-in Counter Sale customer.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type the start their names share in "Search customers".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from COD" opens.
  • Step 3: the list narrows to the case's customers. The list shows {Customer-A} and {Customer-B} (the blank-term customer is listed under COD), never {Customer-C} (search for its name too: it is not there). "Move To" starts empty because COD is the default, and no hint shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S4-R3: “The list holds every customer whose term matches this term ignoring capitals and spaces. On COD it also holds customers with a blank term. The Counter Sale customer is never listed.”
  • S4-R7: “"Move To" offers every active term except the one being moved from, in the S1-R5 order. It is prefilled with the shop's default; while the default is selected, the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." shows below it. When the term being moved from is the default, "Move To" starts empty.”
  • Terminology: “Counter Sale customer → The organization's built-in walk-in customer that over-the-counter sales are invoiced to; there is exactly one per organization, created with the organization. It always stays on COD and is never counted, listed or moved on the Credit Terms page.”
  • S11-R9: “Customers and vendors with a blank term are counted under COD on the Credit Terms page; their records are not changed.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
